description: Generated default formats with intercalary one-day months: the day of a one-day month is its parent's only child, so its number is left out.
verification: The moments are those of the hand-verified to_fields vectors of this calendar (cited in each note) or offsets from them; the texts apply the default format rules of chronology-engine §3.11 to those fields by hand.

cases.note: to-fields-lithe2: '2 Lithe' is the month's name
